facts.fact: NITA-U's own release says its Strategic Plan FY2025/26-2029/30, launched 16 June 2026, targets use of the National Data Centre rising from 70 percent to 83 percent by FY 2029/30; it does not say the plan requires public bodies to host there.

systems.tiers: Ministries, Departments and Agencies (37 percent connected)

note: No hosting or cloud policy is stated; the strategic plan is NITA-U's general plan. The one fact is its National Data Centre utilisation target.
